snippet.title: KochiKame: Ryo-san's Billion-yen Beat - Episode 01：Ryo-san Gets a Game!?
snippet.description:
KochiKame comes to life as a simulation game!
Ryo-san runs wild to save the shopping district! Build an anything-goes shopping street and aim to become a billionaire!

■Wishlist Now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4201590/
